attchmntText: Asian Hotels (West) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Asian Hotels West Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026. The Board considered and approved the Un-Audited Quarterly Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. This approval covers both Standalone and Consolidated results. The financial statements include a Limited Review Report. The meeting started at 03:30 PM and concluded at 07:30 PM IST. The signed financial results and the review report are attached to the filing. The company submitted this information to the BSE and NSE under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.
